Diminutive horn of the lateral meniscus consistent with complex tear. The lateral meniscal body and posterior horn show intrasubstance degeneration without additional tear. No lateral meniscal extrusion. The medial meniscus shows intrasubstance degeneration and slight peripheral extrusion of the body, without tear.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament. Small insertional cysts at the anterior cruciate ligament foot plate.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Mild popliteus tendinosis without tear. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

Attenuated appearance of the medial patellofemoral ligament suggestive of prior tear. Slight lateral patellar subluxation. The lateral patellar retinaculum is intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 12 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Foci of full-thickness cartilage denuding patellar apex, lateral patellar facet, as well as central to lateral femoral trochlea. There is fissuring of articular cartilage throughout the lateral femorotibial compartment. There is mild to moderate medial femorotibial chondrosis.

Trace knee joint fluid. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Complex tear anterior horn lateral meniscus without lateral meniscal extrusion.
2. Popliteus tendinosis without tear.
3. Suspected prior tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament with only slight lateral patellar subluxation.
4. Tricompartment chondrosis most pronounced involving the patellofemoral compartment consistent with moderate to severe patellofemoral predominant tricompartment osteoarthritis of the left knee.

No evidence of significant knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is normal. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues.  
Conclusion: Normal study.

МР находка: МР данни за малък ставен излив. Виждат се артрозни промени във фемуро-пателарната става - хрущялът на фемура е изтънен. Сред изтънения фемурален хрущял се виждат дефекти с липсващи участъци от него. Изобразява се свободен хрущялен фрагмент сред ретропателарния ставен излив. Той е с размер 11/2мм. Хрущялът на тибията и фемура от медиалната страна на ставата е също лекостепенно изтънен. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Дегенеративни промени в заден рог на медиалния менискус. Дорзално от него и дорзално от задната кръстна връзка се изобразява многокамерна ганглион киста с размер в сагитална равнина 30/8мм. Нормално изобразяване на костите, формиращи лявата колянна става. Няма данни за костномозъчен едем. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Сухожилието на м. квадрицепс феморис и лигамент на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Колатерални връзки – запазена цялост. Заключение:  МР данни за хондропатия. Наличие на свободен хондрален фрагмент ретропателарно вътреставно – за артроскопия. Ганглион киста.

There is an undisplaced horizontal oblique tear through the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, along with a small bilobed posteriorly located meniscal cyst. A small joint effusion is present, no loose bodies have been demonstrated.  The lateral meniscus is normal.  The ACL, PCL, medial and lateral collateral ligaments are intact.  The medial and lateral tibiofemoral articular cartilage is well preserved.  
A well-defined ring of sclerosis with internal marrow signal characteristics is noted along the central portion of the lateral femoral condyle, with no surrounding marrow edema like signal change. Such appearances are deemed incidental and completely non aggressive in nature, not requiring any further assessment.  Marrow signal characteristics are otherwise reasonably well-maintained.  
Mild distal femoral trochlear dysplasia with a tiny focus of high-grade cartilage loss and associated subchondral marrow change being noted along the inferior aspect of the lateral retropatellar facet. Incidental note is made of a patella alta morphology as per modified Insall Salvati index. No other finding of note.
